thread:
ben-oncall: Pager triggered 10:03 UTC — widespread 5xx from inference-gateway for model-release 'rev-2026-03-15-rc2'. Seeing tokenizer/vocab errors in a subset of pods. Paging @maya-sre @sara-dev :rotating_light:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0315-001 — high error rate on model rev-2026-03-15-rc2. Severity: P1. On-call: ben-oncall.
deploy-bot: Deploy rev-2026-03-15-rc2 promoted to prod at 09:58 UTC by ci/cd pipeline #build-4521. Tag: model:2026-03-15-rc2, tokenizer:tk-2026-02-11.
maya-sre: Observed logs on shard-7: 
```
ERROR inference: tokenizer mismatch: vocab_size=50260 but weights expect 50257
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/inference/serve.py", line 412, in handle
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(text)
  File "/opt/tokenizer/tokenizer.py", line 88, in encode
    raise TokenError(f"Token ID out of range: {tok}")
TokenError: Token ID out of range: 50258
```
maya-sre: Affected ~12 pods in us-west-2, 4 in eu-west-1. Error spike started at 10:03 UTC. 5xx rate for affected endpoints ~18% of requests.
sara-dev: I rolled the build artifacts earlier but noticed the model artifact index pointed to weightset:weights-2026-02-10 (quantized) while tokenizer alias pointed to tk-2026-02-11 (newer). Looks like the model manifest was merged with inconsistent refs. I think weights vs tokenizer mismatch.
ops-eng: Confirmed metrics: median latency unchanged but error budget burn high. Customer-impact: some high-volume customers hitting 5xx and retries causing user-visible failures. Estimated ~2% user-impact across traffic; for affected endpoints it's ~40% errors.
maya-sre: Recommend immediate flip to stable model alias and disable rolling config. Options: 1) feature-flag kill-switch to pin model alias to stable; 2) rollback deploy to last known-good artifact; 3) emergency hotpatch to replace tokenizer on affected pods. Fastest is flag flip.
sara-dev: Agreed. Executing flag flip now. Command: 
```
# disable model rolling for prod
redwoodctl feature-flag set model.dynamic_rollout false --env prod --actor sara-dev
# pin alias
redwoodctl model alias set inference/default stable-v1.24 --env prod --actor sara-dev
```
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: model.dynamic_rollout=false by sara-dev at 10:12:08 UTC. Alias operation queued.
ben-oncall: Flipped flag. Starting controlled restart of affected pods. prod-runbook step 3: `pin-alias-then-evict` in progress.
ops-eng: Rolling eviction on shard-7 started at 10:13 UTC. Evicting 3 pods/minute.
incident-bot: NOTIFICATION: customers potentially affected: partner-a, partner-b. Ops notifications channel updated.
product-ops: I'm drafting a brief customer message and an incident page. Need ETA on full recovery.
maya-sre: After alias pin and pod restart, initial traffic shows error rate down to ~1.2% at 10:20 UTC. Some pods still warming KV caches; will watch for regressions.
sara-dev: Root cause hypothesis: manifest merge conflict in release branch where tokenizer alias moved forward but weightset stayed on previous stable; automated promotion script didn't validate tokenizer+weight compatibility. I'm opening a PR to add a manifest compatibility check in pipeline.
ben-oncall: Good. For now leave dynamic_rollout=false until we finish postmortem. Can we get a terse rollback summary for the pager?
sara-dev: Rollback action: pinned alias inference/default -> stable-v1.24 (was rev-2026-03-15-rc2), disabled dynamic rollout. Impact: error rate dropped from 18% -> ~1.2% in 8 minutes. No additional customer-facing mitigations required at this time.
ops-eng: Marking incident as UNDER CONTROL at 10:28 UTC. Pager duty: start extended monitoring window 2 hours.
ben-oncall: Handoff to morning oncall @maya-sre for postmortem and follow-ups. Maya, please own the postmortem and coordinate with sara-dev to get pipeline guard in.
maya-sre: Will take it. Creating INC ticket with timeline and assigning postmortem owner. Action items: (1) pipeline validation, (2) add manifest schema check, (3) release process doc update, (4) customer comms follow-up.
product-ops: Customer note draft in #customer-ops: "We've identified a model-tokenizer mismatch in the March 15 deployment causing transient errors. We've pinned affected traffic to the previous model and are monitoring. We'll follow up with RCA."
sara-dev: I'll follow up with a short retro and the PR link. PR will include a unit test that verifies tokenizer vocab_size == model.expected_vocab.
ben-oncall: Thanks all. Closing pager but leaving incident open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
